summary: Opened the client-contract side of proposal completion with an executable probe. With commit notification enabled, the harness proposes once, drives committed then applied, and reads both result channels; it then proposes again with a three-tick deadline, advances the clock past it, applies the entry, and reads both channels again. Four CA_EVENT lines record the observed result codes or 'none', so the next turn can check the documented two-phase delivery and whether an expired proposal ends with a single timeout and no stray commit notification. Registered the investigation and cited the ResultC contract and shard apply path; no conclusion before the receipt.
